thread:
maya: Quick check  I start Jan 2 but offer says PTO starts immediately. Do I get any prorated days for Dec hires or is it only from first full month?

jess (People Ops): Welcome aboard! We prorate by days in your first partial month. Since your start is Jan 2, you get the prorated accrual for January (days worked / days in month). No retroactive Dec credit unless contract explicitly grants it.

linh: Related: my partner's country has a floating religious holiday in early Jan. Can I swap one of my company shutdown days for that day?

jess (People Ops): You can request a holiday swap 14 days in advance via the portal. Swaps are 1:1 and don't affect carryover caps. If swap falls during company shutdown, we count the observed holiday first and swap the other day if still eligible.

omar (manager): For small teams, what guidance on approving >2 people off during the shutdown?

jess (People Ops): Managers should submit a coverage rotation plan by Dec 10. If >2 people conflict, propose cross-team coverage or staggered half-days. We'll accept reasonable comp-time plans if hiring interviews or business-critical work require people to be active.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: "Carryover cap 40h. Exceptions require manager + people-ops approval and must be filed by Jan 31 (medical exceptions accepted later with docs)."

maya: Thanks  I'll submit a swap request and my start-date prorate looks clear.

jess (People Ops): Ping me if you want help with the portal form. We'll confirm the exact prorated hours after payroll processes your hire date.
